student_summary.headline: Manchester A100
student_summary.status_message: This representative International applicant meets the implemented minimum gates. UCAT 2100 falls in the 2060-2149 historical International guidance band, producing a good-chance recommendation. This recommendation is based on historical international interview competitiveness rather than a fixed UCAT cut-off. It is not a current UCAT cut-off.
key_points: Seven represented GCSE grades are at 7, with English Language and Mathematics at 6 and two sciences at 7.

The three full A levels forming the offer are AAA: Chemistry satisfies the first required science condition, Biology is a distinct approved second subject, and History is an unrestricted third subject.
UCAT is present for the application cycle and SJT Band 2 passes the Band 1-2 gate.
International applicants compete only within Manchester's separate International cohort.
UCAT 2100 maps to the 2060-2149 historical International guidance band.
This recommendation is based on historical international interview competitiveness rather than a fixed UCAT cut-off. It is not a current UCAT cut-off.
Only a verified MAP completer meeting all minimum criteria receives a guaranteed interview.
